correctness.rationale: Generator closure yields an exact killed first-passage representation (1), and the equilibrium-age renewal formula (3) yields (4). For fixed positive temperature, the exponential tilt produces iid one-step descent times with finite tilted mean; the law of large numbers and a Chernoff left-tail bound give the exponential-times-power prefactor. At zero temperature, Mellin inversion plus rigorous domination gives the inverse first-passage moment constant; a Poisson event bound removes the finite age cutoff. Exact Toeplitz covariance summation gives all three variance regimes and strict susceptibility threshold. The standalone checker passed 324 independent finite algebraic, integration and monotonicity assertions; no finite experiment is treated as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The motivating 2026 primary paper identifies spatial correlations under heavy-tailed global reset as a mathematical gap. A sharp temperature-dependent change from n^{-q} eta^n to n^{-2q}, with explicit constants, and a divergent-to-finite integrated spin-correlation transition at α=3/2 govern macroscopic block fluctuations. This natural phase-boundary classification has physical interpretation and is not a toy substitution or arbitrary finite numerical case.
